title: Niyabagal Thalattum
desc: Abhiram meets Nandini and falls for her. But, he has no clue to her whereabouts. While visiting a family friend's house for a wedding, he realises that the bride-to-be is none other than Nandini.

title: Duet
desc: Two musician brothers, Guna and Siva, end up falling in love with Anjali, a choreographer. However, the brothers have a rift when Siva becomes possessive of Anjali.

title: Rajavum 5 Koojavum
desc: A group of people embark on a journey to Sri Lanka, but they are confronted with numerous problems over the course of their journey. Soon, they start to question the purpose of their travel.

title: Pandiyan
desc: Pandiyan, a police officer, is enraged when his sister's husband dies. In order to find and catch the culprits, he goes undercover

title: Majaa
desc: Aadhi and Mathi, along with their father, go to a village and help a retired officer pay off his debts to a landlord. Soon, Mathi forcibly marries the landlord's daughter to teach him a lesson.

title: Naam
desc: A dreaded terrorist's attempt at fleeing the country forever is foiled by the police and his brother is killed in the shootout. He then employs four out-of-work youths to hijack a plane.

title: Kalai Jan
desc: Pop singer Inderjeet is the main suspect after his female fans are killed by a serial killer. Divya, whose sister was a dancer in his troupe and the first target, comes to the city to find the killer.

title: Jathi Malli
desc: After her mother's murder, singer Sriranjani moves to Ooty and meets Kesavan, another dejected soul. Along come two run-away lovers, who bring a fresh perspective to the lives of these two.

title: Parthen Rasithen
desc: Shankar, a graduate, awaits recruitment and lives as a tenant with Bhanu who seeks his company to stay away from her stepbrother. Meanwhile, Shankar begins to fall in love with Sarika.

title: 5 Star
desc: Five college friends promise to stay together even after completing their education. However, one of them hides from the others that he has been forced to marry a village girl.

title: Vaanatha Pola
desc: Vellaichaamy sacrifices love for his three brothers, resisting marriage when he discovers his beloved intends to separate them.

title: Naan Rajavaaga Pogiren
desc: Jeeva, who leads a good life in Himachal Pradesh, learns that he has a lookalike, Raja, who is a boxer in Chennai. Intrigued by the notion, Jeeva sets out on an adventurous journey to find Raja.

title: Vandi
desc: Three roommates, who are trying to make their ends meet, land in trouble due to a stolen bike that has been extensively used by robbers for executing their plans

title: Pandiya Naadu
desc: Shiva's perfect life turns upside down after his brother is killed by a dreaded gangster. Bent on revenge, Shiva turns into a ruthless killer and vows to eliminate his brother's killers.

title: Nageswary
desc: A night before her wedding, Nagaveni and her brother are assaulted and killed by her fiance, Eashwar, and his friends. However, she rises from the dead and sets out to take revenge on them.

title: Acharam
desc: Suriya, a sub-inspector, hates modern women and kills them secretly at night. When he meets Ramya, the wife of an architect, he becomes obsessed with her.

title: Vanmam
desc: Friends Radha and Chelladurai lead a carefree life. When Radha accidentally kills Chelladurai's brother-in-law, it turns them bitter foes, and a cunning man uses their enmity to his benefits
